extracted.name: Popa’s Pickled Eggs
extracted.description: Popa’s pickled eggs recipe is simple to make. They start with hard-cooked eggs and jarred yellow peppers, pickling spices, turmeric, sugar, and vinegar.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) jar hot yellow peppers with brine
instruction_lines: Stir water, peppers and brine, vinegar, pickling spice, sugar, salt, and turmeric together in a ½-gallon mason jar or container. Add eggs; seal container. Refrigerate for at least 2 days.
